name: Sister Ilsa
appearance: A grey shawl over a singer's plain robe; a voice that carries across a square.
voice: Sung more than spoken; falters when she's caught out.
backstory: Ilsa leads the Choir's singing. She hurried the crowned Kitwin off the dais on the night of day 2, and on day 9 led an Ashward crowd to Okton's forge, until Chadickith asked why the Choir would knife Isine if it already held the Coal; she stumbled and withdrew.
wants: The hymn to hold; Kitwin crowned.
fears: The crowd turning on the Choir, as it did at the forge.
secrets: She knows what the Last Ember is and what the wafers do.
The Choir's hymns hold Kitwin's rage down.
dm_only: (Invented by the NPC creator: by the Choir's faith she is likely a Singer, holding the burn under her own song.)
Sheet built by the NPC creator as a Bard (invented: class and numbers).

relationships.name: Kitwin
relationships.how: she keeps him close and sings his rage down

relationships.name: Chadickith
relationships.how: the loxodon who turned her crowd

traits.name: Bardic Inspiration
traits.text: Three times per long rest, a d6 inspiration die as a bonus action.

traits.name: Jack of All Trades
traits.text: Adds +1 to ability checks she isn't proficient in.

traits.name: Song of Rest
traits.text: Allies regain an extra 1d6 hit points during a short rest she sings through.
